message.content: 在2020年的影壇上，最受矚目且被廣泛認為是年度最佳影片的作品是《寄生虫》（Parasite）。這部由奉俊昊執導的韓國黑色喜劇驚悚片不僅在各大影展獲得多項殊榮（包括第93屆奧斯卡金像獎最佳影片、最佳導演、最佳原創劇本和最佳國際長片），還在全球範圍內贏得了觀眾與評論家的高度評價。其對階級衝突的深刻描繪、緊湊的敘事節奏以及出人意料的結局，使它成為2020年最具代表性、最具影響力的電影之一。
message.reasoning: The user asks "2020年最佳電影是什麼？" which translates to "What was the best movie of 2020?" They want an answer. There's no function call needed. Just respond with an answer. Probably mention some award winners like "Parasite" won Best Picture at Oscars 2020 (though ceremony held in 2021). Or "Nomadland" won Best Picture at 2021 Oscars but it's 2020 film. But the question is ambiguous. We can give a general answer: "Parasite" was widely acclaimed and won many awards. Also "1917" etc. But likely they want a single answer. I'll answer: "《寄生虫》" (Parasite) was considered the best film of 2020.
